caption:
A lot of manager stress is saying the soft version, then feeling resentful when they miss the real point.

Save this for the next message you’re about to soften too much.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #feedback

messages.name: You say
messages.text: “Take another pass when you have a sec.”

messages.name: You say
messages.text: “I just want to make sure we’re aligned.”

messages.name: You mean
messages.text: “I need you to do it differently.”

slides.headline: Don’t make them <u>decode</u> you.
slides.sub: Soft words often create more stress, not less.
